content.text: Oliver Proudfute, mistaken for Henry Smith because he wears Henry’s armor, is murdered by Bonthron, Ramorny’s assassin. Perth citizens demand justice; Henry becomes champion for Oliver’s widow and defeats Bonthron in combat. Bonthron falsely accuses Prince Rothsay, then is hanged but secretly rescued by Dwining and Eviot from the gallows and taken by boat toward Newburgh. Rothsay is confined at the Constable’s lodgings, then escapes by boat with Ramorny and Dwining to Falkland, where they plot against him. Meanwhile, Simon Glover and Catharine flee Perth: Catharine seeks refuge under Duchess Marjory, while Simon travels to Loch Tay and the Clan Quhele. Conachar, now chief, reveals he is a coward and loves Catharine; Simon refuses the match. On returning to Falkland, Rothsay is prepared to encounter Catharine.
